Accordion.note: `.Item` needs `value`; open one with `defaultValue`. Wrap panel content in a single element.

ActivityFeed.note: `.Item` must be a direct child. `avatar` short-circuits `icon`.

Alert.note: `statusIcon` accepts an icon-name string; `statusIcon: null` drops the glyph.

AnimatePresence.note: `show` is required. `setState` writes a literal, so use two controls rather than a toggle.

AppShell.note: `.SidebarLink` needs `to`; its `icon` takes an icon-name string. Router-aware links need a host adapter.

Avatar.note: Falls back to initials from `name`. `AvatarGroup`'s `size` does not reach children through the renderer — set it per avatar.

Badge.note: `statusIcon` accepts an icon-name string. A `<span>` — never make it clickable.

Breadcrumbs.note: `aria-current` is manual — set `current: true` on the last crumb.

Button.note: Defaults to `type="button"` — a submit button must say so explicitly.

Calendar.note: Date props accept ISO `YYYY-MM-DD` strings. `isDateDisabled` and `renderDay` are functions and unreachable.

Carousel.note: `.Track` is **not** optional — without it the arrows never appear. No autoplay.

CodeBlock.note: Takes a `code` string and no children. No syntax highlighting.

Collapsible.note: Use `defaultOpen`. Never pass `id` to `.Trigger` or `.Content` — it breaks the aria wiring silently.

ColorPicker.note: Hex only; anything else silently becomes `#000000`. Submits nothing.

Combobox.note: Owns no data: every `.Item` needs a gapless `index` and a `value`. Filtering is the author's job.

CommandPalette.note: Give it a literal `id`. `items[].onSelect` accepts a declarative handler object. Children compose one row; see Children a component calls.

Container.note: Always a `<div>` — use `Stack as="section"` when you need the landmark.

ContextMenu.note: Every `.Item` needs a gapless `index`. `.Trigger` has no accessible name — give it one. Scope it to an object, never a page.

CopyButton.note: Requires `value`. Silently no-ops outside a secure context.

DataTable.note: `rowKey` is required: pass the **column name as a string**. A column may carry a `render` cell template as `{"$node": …}`, bound to `row`/`rowIndex`.

DatePicker.note: ISO date strings on `value`/`defaultValue`/`min`/`max`. Pass `name` or nothing is submitted.

DateRangePicker.note: `value`/`defaultValue` are `{ start, end }` of ISO strings. Rest props land on the wrapper.

Dialog.note: Give it a literal `id` — the renderer owns `open`/`onClose` so `openDialog`/`closeDialog` can target it. No accessible name of its own: point `aria-labelledby` at your title. A close control comes from `DialogHeader`, not from the panel.

DialogBody.note: The only part of a panel that scrolls, and only beside `DialogHeader` — a panel of bare children distributes the shortfall across all of them and clips instead. Adds no padding of its own; the panel already has the gutter.

DialogHeader.note: The row that holds a panel's title and stays put. Renders a close control only when given `onClose` — wire it to `closeDialog` with the panel's `id`, and name it with `closeLabel`. Put it first: the panel opens focused on its first focusable descendant.

Divider.note: A vertical divider renders nothing outside a flex/grid parent with a cross-axis height.

Drawer.note: As `Dialog`. Escape is the only built-in dismissal — render your own close control.

DropdownMenu.note: Every `.Item` needs a gapless `index`. `onSelect` takes a handler directly. Avoid `asChild`.

EmptyState.note: Its four parts are flat exports (`EmptyStateIcon`, **not** `EmptyState.Icon`) but must nest inside this root.

ErrorBoundary.note: Largely redundant: the renderer already wraps every node. Its `fallback` is unreachable from JSON.

Field.note: `name: "form.field"` surfaces the live error. It does **not** wire `Label`/control ids — do that yourself.

FieldError.note: `name: "form.field"`. Renders nothing when there is no error, so it is safe to always include.

Grid.note: 1–6 columns only; anything else silently falls back to one.

Hero.note: `Hero.Background` takes no children. Put anything that must stay legible in `Hero.Content`.

HoverCard.note: Never opens on touch and its content is unreachable by keyboard — never put unique information there.

Icon.note: Added by this package, not the library. `name` is resolved from the injected icon set.

IconButton.note: Requires `aria-label`. The glyph is a **child** `Icon` node, not an `icon` prop.

Label.note: No automatic association — pair `htmlFor` with the control's `id`.

MasonryGrid.note: Pass `animate: false` unless a viewport observer will run — items start at `opacity: 0`.

Markdown.note: `children` is source **text**, concatenated verbatim — not nodes. Fenced blocks become `CodeBlock`s and pipe tables become `Table`s, so reach for it instead of hand-composing prose.

MediaCard.note: `.Image` requires `alt`, and its `className` addresses the ratio box — `loading`, `srcSet`, `sizes` and friends belong in `imgProps`. The card is only as tall as its image and clips overflow.

Meter.note: Requires `value` and `aria-label`. Thresholds compare the raw value, not a fraction.

MultiSelect.note: Requires `options`. Give it `aria-label` — it derives no name and posts nothing natively. Children compose the chips and listbox; see Children a component calls.

NumberInput.note: Submits raw text — `min`/`max`/`step` are advisory only.

OTPInput.note: Name it with `aria-labelledby` — a `<div>` cannot be a `Label` target.

Pagination.note: Controlled-only — no `defaultPage`. Seed `spec.state` and feed `onPageChange` from `event.value`.

Parallax.note: Moves outside its own layout box — clip on a parent.

Popover.note: `openDialog` does **not** reach it — use `defaultOpen` or its own trigger. Name `.Content`, which also takes `arrow: true`.

Portal.note: Renders to `document.body`. `themeOverrides` scoped to the view do not reach it.

ProgressBar.note: Takes no children: `.Label` and `.Value` are **siblings** of the bar. Needs `value` and a name.

ProgressRing.note: No default accessible name — pass `aria-label`. The centre slot is decorative.

Radio.note: `value` is the option's identity, so use the **bare** binding: `{ "value": "…", "$field": "…" }`.

RangeCalendar.note: `value`/`defaultValue` are `{ start, end }` of ISO strings.

RangeSlider.note: `defaultValue` is a two-number array. No native form participation.

Rating.note: Requires `aria-label`. Not a form control; `readOnly` is the JSON-native shape.

RequireAuth.note: `status` is a string, so `{"$ref": …}` drives it. Always supply `redirect` — otherwise `unauthenticated` renders nothing.

ScrollReveal.note: Starts at `opacity: 0`. Set `animate: false` wherever the text is the point; `animation: "none"` reveals with no entrance class.

SearchInput.note: Controlled-only: bind it with `$field` or it cannot be typed in.

Select.note: Takes an `options` array; the renderer turns it into `<option>` children.

Skeleton.note: Sized by `className` on both axes (`w-[40%] h-3`); it has no `width`/`height` props. A `circular` one needs one axis only.

Slider.note: Pass `aria-label`, and `aria-valuetext` on any non-percentage scale.

Sparkline.note: Requires `values`. `bar` measures from zero already; `line`/`area` frame to the data, so pass `min`/`max` to fix the scale.

Spotlight.note: `.Item`s must be flat children of the root. `.Image` requires `src`. Pass `animate: false`.

Stack.note: `as` is a document's only route to a raw HTML tag (`"section"`, `"ul"`, `"form"`).

Stagger.note: Ships no animation of its own; inert unless the host styles `.stagger-item`.

StatCard.note: `.Trend` needs `value` and `direction` and takes no children. `.Sparkline` needs `values`.

Stepper.note: `activeStep` is required and fully controlled; it may equal the step count, meaning "all done".

Swimlane.note: Requires `title`. It does **not** scroll despite the name; nest a `Carousel` or an overflow `Row`.

Switch.note: `$field` binds `checked` and writes back through `onCheckedChange`. Needs `aria-label`.

Table.note: Presentational only — it sorts nothing. Rest props land on a wrapper; name it via `tableProps`.

Tabs.note: `defaultValue` is required, and every `.Tab`/`.Panel` `value` must match or the tab is dead. `.Panel` is a sibling of `.List`.

TagInput.note: Values are plain strings; `$field` stores an array. `className` is the whole control — the bordered box is `classNames.control`.

Text.note: A heading `variant` emits a real heading element — pass `as: "p"` for heading-sized body text.

ThemeSwitcher.note: `themes` doubles as a filter, and persistence is write-only. It fights `spec.theme` over the same attribute.

Timeline.note: `.Item` requires `title`. Pass `animate: false` — every item otherwise builds its own observer.

Toast.note: Prefer the `showToast` action. Rendered by hand it needs `onDismiss` and its own `$cond` to unmount.

Tooltip.note: Takes `content` and exactly one child. `arrow: true` draws a pointer at the resolved side.

ViewTransition.note: `name` must be unique. Inert unless the host's navigate adapter wraps `startViewTransition`.

Wizard.note: `steps[].content` is a ReactNode — express it as `{"$node": …}`.
